category_edits.rationale: Across all four datasets, jointly set Adam learning rate to 1.2e-3 and input dropout to 0.05. Lower dropout reduces input noise while the modestly higher learning rate accelerates adaptation. This explores a different configuration from the evaluated lower-learning-rate, higher-dropout trials. Preserve architecture, embedding parameterization, readout, loss, seeds, training limits and one checkpoint per category; existing predictor plumbing remains compatible.

response.change_summary: Tune shared dropout to 0.05 and Adam learning rate to 1.2e-3 for all four independent GRU4Rec category models.
